svg.aria-label: How the code is layered, from runtime to pixels. marmot-c, the Rust Marmot runtime for MLS groups, relays and storage, bound only in marmot/marmot.odin. Worker threads in app/workers.odin keep sends and subscriptions off the UI thread. Their results drain between frames into Ui_State, one struct in app/state.odin. Every frame, nendo in app/nendo/ rebuilds the layout tree and SDL3 through app/sdlrl/ draws it.
